title: Damage Waiver Fees, Deductibles and Exclusions by Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Class
content:
A renter of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental chooses at the counter between no waiver, the basic damage waiver and the premium damage waiver. Each waiver has a fee charged per rental period and a deductible, which is the renter's share of covered vehicle damage under that waiver. The figures differ by vehicle class.

## Waiver fees and deductibles

| Vehicle class | Basic waiver fee, per rental period (USD) | Basic waiver deductible (USD) | Premium waiver fee, per rental period (USD) | Premium waiver deductible (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 14.00 | 500.00 | 22.00 | 0.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 14.00 | 500.00 | 22.00 | 0.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 18.00 | 750.00 | 28.00 | 0.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 22.00 | 1000.00 | 34.00 | 0.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 26.00 | 1000.00 | 38.00 | 0.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 30.00 | 1500.00 | 44.00 | 0.00 |

## Liability without a waiver, overhead exclusion and void conditions

| Vehicle class | Owed for damage with no waiver | Overhead-strike damage to the cargo box roof or cab-over excluded from both waivers | Conditions under which a waiver does not apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | Full repair estimate | No | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | Full repair estimate | No | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | Full repair estimate | Yes | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | Full repair estimate | Yes | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | Full repair estimate | Yes | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | Full repair estimate | Yes | Unauthorized driver; driving under the influence; off-road use; overloaded |

## Notes on the schedule

- The premium waiver deductible is 0.00 on every class.
- The overhead exclusion is "No" on the Bluegate Pickup Truck and the Bluegate Cargo Van and "Yes" on the four moving trucks from 10 ft to 26 ft.
- The four void conditions are the same list for every class.
- Both waiver fees are charged per rental period, so the fee figure in the table is the amount for one period.
